light.line: Volunteers from the Lebanon and Laclede County area spent a Saturday in September restoring the Colonel Miles Vernon Cemetery. Some folks just won't let history gather weeds.
Camdenton R-III broke ground Oct. 27 on its new Early Childhood Center, and preschoolers stole the show. Tough crowd to follow for the grown-ups.
Camdenton football is a generational program, with the same families returning to play on the same field. Dads pass down more than a playbook.
